behavior: Native non-anonymous identity, Product IQ governance and mapped active organization are required before a bounded request. The configured standard server Anthropic model performs at most three web searches, then extracts at most ten research proposals from retrieved cited evidence. Citations must match actual search-result URLs; recency/date, required fields and official recall sources are checked. Tenant-owned governed requests persist proposals and token/search metadata without modifying shared news/recall facts. Prepared PIM sends session authorization, removes browser provider-key collection, and safely renders proposal sources.
limits: No real provider request or signed-in browser run was performed. Actual configured model/search availability, provider account settings and end-to-end citations need verification.
Only official CPSC and Health Canada recall evidence is accepted; manufacturer-only or uncited recall assertions are rejected.
AI citations show provenance and do not prove every assertion. Proposals require review; an approved publish/apply workflow and saved-proposal retrieval remain pending.
Provider calls are bounded to two 45-second requests, 4096 output tokens each, 1 MiB response per call, three searches and ten items. Pause/tool errors or unsupported responses fail closed.

Tokens, including available cache usage, are metered through the existing completion broker. Search count is retained in proposal metadata; this change does not add a separate monetary search-charge meter.
No DDL, hosted app cutover, source retirement or final database/Storage delta transfer was performed.
